segments.he: ספרו לפני רבינו ז"ל על הרב הצדיק מוה"ר נחום מטשערנאביל ז"ל שכאשר הי' מגיע להדלקת נר חנוכה (פעם הראשון) עשה קפיצה מלא קומתו מחמת גודל האור שהי' מרגיש ואמר רבינו ז"ל שזה מחמת שלא הי' מכין עצמו כ"כ על האור הזה מקודם איזה זמן כמו רבינו ז"ל שהי' מכין א"ע כמה זמן קודם בהתבודדות והכנת כלים קבל האור ע"כ כשהי 'מגיע להדלקת נר חנוכה וכו' אפי' איזה אור שהי' מרגיש לא הי' קופץ כי הי' לו כבר כלים לקבל וכן קודם כל יו"ט עשה הכנות כלים בהתבודדות וכו'.
segments.en: One of our fellowship was traveling to Uman for Rosh HaShanah and encountered a certain man on the road, who challenged him with all manner of arguments: "How can you travel away from home before Yom Tov?" He replied: "There is upon me and upon all my household and family a literal decree of death and a capital verdict — and in Uman there is a great advocate who, no matter how the verdict stands, one hundred percent works for good. Therefore I am certainly compelled — without any argument or response, without looking at anything at all, not at home, not at Yom Tov — only to save my soul and the souls of my family." And the other man nodded his head that this reasoning was correct. [And the one from our fellowship meant by this: the Day of Judgment is coming, and according to what one feels in oneself, certainly one would be found guilty in judgment — for even the angels are seized with trembling, and there is no righteous person on earth who has not sinned. And this is a judgment that concerns him and all his family and all those dependent on him for all eternity. And there is a counsel and remedy — to travel for Rosh HaShanah and rely on the power of the Tzaddikim — and certainly it will turn out for the very best for him and his descendants for all time. May Hashem grant us this soon, amen.]
